# Configuration reference

Every setting, where it comes from, and what it accepts. Generated from
`Settings` and `NUMERIC_RANGES`, so this table cannot describe a field that no
longer exists.

## How a value is resolved

Later wins:

1. the default in `Settings`;
2. `DUBFORGE_<NAME>` in the environment (booleans accept `1/true/yes/on` and
   `0/false/no/off` only — anything else warns and keeps the default);
3. a JSON file passed with `--config` (unknown keys are an error, not a shrug);
4. a command-line flag.

A settings file is validated on load: invalid JSON, a non-object root, an unknown
key, a wrong type, `NaN`/`Infinity` or an out-of-range value is a `ConfigError`
naming the file and the key. `dubforge validate-config` checks one without
starting any work.

## Limits

The limits are refusals, not warnings. They are checked in `plan()` before the
first paid call and again between stages while running, and the error names the
setting to change.

| Limit | Default | What happens when it is hit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `max_input_bytes` | 4 GiB | `limit_exceeded` before any provider call |
| `max_input_seconds` | 4 h | `limit_exceeded` before any provider call |
| `max_run_seconds` | 4 h | the run stops at the next stage boundary |
| `max_estimated_usd` | 25.0 | `plan()` reports the breach; the run will not start |
| `max_concurrent_jobs` | 2 | further jobs stay `queued` until a slot frees |
| `max_retries` | 2 | per provider HTTP call; `Retry-After` is honoured |
| `job_retention_days` | 30 | `jobs cleanup` default horizon |

## Examples

A school lab that must not spend more than ₹500 a term and must not leave the
machine:

```bash
export DUBFORGE_MAX_ESTIMATED_USD=6
export DUBFORGE_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS=1
export DUBFORGE_MAX_INPUT_MINUTES=45   # not a setting: use MAX_INPUT_SECONDS
export DUBFORGE_MAX_INPUT_SECONDS=2700
dubforge dub lesson.mp4 --to hi --asr faster_whisper --translator ollama --tts edge_tts
```

A studio that wants the best voice and accepts the bill:

```bash
export DUBFORGE_MAX_ESTIMATED_USD=250
export DUBFORGE_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS=4
dubforge dub feature.mp4 --to hi --asr deepgram --translator openai --tts elevenlabs \
  --voice-pool <id> --fallback
```
